article.title: Alternancia indicativo/subjuntivo en completivas
article.part: Coordinación y subordinación — Coordenação e subordinação
article.chapter: Subordinación sustantiva y completiva — Subordinação substantiva e completiva

claims.summary: Portuguese alternates between indicative and subjunctive in completive clauses based on the content of the subordinate clause.
Indicative is used with verbs and expressions presenting content as fact or assumed belief, while subjunctive appears with desirability, doubt, possibility, necessity, valuation, or reaction.
The rule 'Certainty = indicative' and 'Doubt = subjunctive' is a first approximation but does not exhaust the system.
